You can make out a fridge. The fridge contains a raw pork chop. You can make out an oven. You wonder idly who left that here. You can see a table. The table is massive. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it? You see a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you see a knife. You can see a stove. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is an open frosted-glass door leading north. You need an exit without a door? You should try going east. There is an exit to the west.

There is a white onion on the floor.
